公司簡介
Corporate Profile




                                                                                                       廣州馥香園
                                                                                                       Guangzhou Fuxiangyuan




綠城中國控股有限公司是中國領先的優質房產品開發及生活綜合服務供應商，以優秀的產品質
量、獨特的建築美學、以人為本的服務保持行業引領地位。公司連續二十二年榮獲「中國房地產
百強企業綜合實力Top10」1 ，所進駐重點城市客戶滿意度連續十五年保持領先，並連續四年榮獲
產品力測評榜第一 2 ，此外還獲得「2025中國房地產百強企業穩健性Top10」1 、「2025中國房企品
牌價值Top3」1等榮譽。

Greentown China Holdings Limited is a leading quality property developer and an integrated living
service provider in China. It maintains a leadership position in the industry by virtue of the quality of
its properties, its unique architectural aesthetics, and its customer-centric services. The Company has
been awarded the “Top10 among 100 Chinese Real Estate Enterprises by Comprehensive Strength” 1
for 22 consecutive years and maintained a leading position in customer satisfaction in core cities in
which it operates for 15 consecutive years as well as ranked first in the product strength assessment
lists for four consecutive years. It has also received honors such as “Top10 among 100 Chinese Real
Estate Enterprises by Stability in 2025”1 and “Top3 Chinese Real Estate Companies by Brand Value”1.

                                                                                    杭州蕙瀾月華

董事會主席及非執行董事               Chairman of the Board and Non-Executive Director
劉成雲先生                     Mr LIU Chengyun




2025年，是綠城中國的而立之年，也是「戰略2025」的收官之年。這一年，房地產行業的深度調
整仍在持續，市場寒意未消，行業發展的不確定性依舊存在。面對複雜嚴峻的外部環境，綠城始
終堅守初心，以經營安全為底線，以現金流為根本，以品質為核心抓手，在行業的疾風驟雨中穩
健前行。

The year 2025 marks both the 30th anniversary of Greentown China and the final year of its “Strategy
2025”. In this year, the real estate industry continued to undergo deep adjustments with lingering
market chill and persisting uncertainties surrounding industry development. Facing a complex
and severe external environment, Greentown has always remained true to its original aspiration by
insisting on operational safety as the essence, cash flow as foundation, and quality as core focus,
steadily navigating through the industry’s turbulences.

                                                                                                       武漢湖畔雲廬

經營回顧                                        Operation Review
2025年，房地產市場仍處於深度調整期，供需兩                     In 2025, the real estate market still lingered in a deep adjustment phase, with

股份激勵計劃                                            Share Award Scheme
本公司已採納股份激勵計劃（「股份激勵計劃」），                           The Company has adopted a share award scheme (the “Share Award Scheme”),
根據該計劃，本公司可安排受託人（「受託人」）從                           pursuant to which, the Company can arrange the trustee (the “Trustee”) to
公開市場為該計劃設立的信託（「信託」）購買待獎                           purchase the Shares to be awarded for the trust constituted for the Scheme (the
勵的股份，並為經選定僱員以信託形式持有，                              “Trust”) from the open market and held on trust for the selected employees until
直至該等股份根據計劃規則歸屬於相關經選定僱                             such Shares are vested with the relevant selected employees in accordance

      得款項確認為抵押借款。                     received.

      幅增加（減少）。長期空置率及貼現率單獨                                 increase (decrease) in the fair value of the investment properties. A

      價值作出的假設的變動會導致租金年增長                                  in the fair value of the investment properties. Generally, a change in

      率出現反向變動。                                            by a directionally similar change in the rent growth per annum and the

17.   租賃                                         17.      Leases
      本集團作為承租人                                            The Group as a lessee
      本集團就樓宇及租賃土地訂立租賃合同。                                  The Group has lease contracts for buildings and leasehold lands. Lump
      已向業主提前作出一次性付款以獲得租期                                  sum payments were made upfront to acquire the leased land from the
      為20至50年的租賃土地，根據該等土地租                                owners with lease periods of 20 to 50 years, and no ongoing payments

41.   退休福利計劃                         41.     Retirement Benefits Plans
      本集團在中國內地的附屬公司僱員屬政府                     The employees of the Group’s subsidiaries in Mainland China are
      營運的國家管理退休福利計劃成員。該等                     members of the state-managed retirement benefits schemes operated
      附屬公司須將發薪的若干百分比向退休福                     by the government. These subsidiaries are required to contribute a
      利計劃供款，以為該等福利提供資金。本                     certain percentage of payroll costs to the retirement benefits schemes
      集團對退休福利計劃的唯一責任是作出所                     to fund the benefits. The only obligation of the Group with respect to the
      規定供款。                                  retirement benefits schemes is to make the specified contributions.

      級                               Instruments
      管理層已評估，銀行結餘及現金、抵押銀              Management has assessed that the fair values of bank balances and
      行存款、貿易及其他應收款項、訂金及預              cash, pledged bank deposits, trade and other receivables, deposits and
      付款項、應收╱應付關聯人士款項、貿易              prepayments, amounts due from/to related parties, trade and other
      及其他應付款項以及銀行及其他借款流動              payables, the current portion of bank and other borrowings approximate
      部分的公平值與其賬面值相若，主要由於              to their carrying amounts largely due to the short-term maturities of these
      該等工具於短期內到期。                     instruments.


      管理層負責釐定金融工具公平值計量的政              Management is responsible for determining the policies and procedures
      策及程序。於各報告日期，管理層分析金              for the fair value measurement of financial instruments. At each reporting
      融工具價值的變動情況，並釐定估值中所              date, management analyses the movements in the values of financial
      用的主要輸入數據。估值過程及結果經董              instruments and determines the major inputs applied in the valuation. The
      事會一年討論兩次，以進行中期及年度財              valuation process and results are discussed with the Board twice a year
      務匯報。                            for interim and annual financial reporting.


      金融資產及負債的公平值計入自願雙方可              The fair values of the financial assets and liabilities are included at
      於當前交易（脅迫或清盤銷售除外）中交換             the amount at which the instrument could be exchanged in a current
      該工具所需的金額。估計公平值使用以下              transaction between willing parties, other than in a forced or liquidation
      方法及假設：                          sale. The following methods and assumptions were used to estimate the
                                      fair values:


      按公平值計入損益的金融資產（指投資公司             The fair values of the financial assets at fair value through profit or loss,
      及銀行發行的理財產品）公平值按使用擁有             which represent wealth management products issued by investment
      類似條款、信貸風險及餘下到期期限的工              companies and wealth management products issued by banks, have

      於管理流動資金風險時，本集團監察及維              In the management of the liquidity risk, the Group monitors and maintains
      持現金及現金等價物於管理層認為適當的              a level of cash and cash equivalents deemed adequate by management
      水平，以為本集團的營運提供資金及減輕              to finance the Group’s operations and mitigate the effects of fluctuations

      要的流動資金來源。                       source of liquidity.

      商。這導致本集團需要與單一交易方結算              This results in the Group being required to settle a significant amount with
      大額金額，而非與多家供應商結算較小金              a single counterparty, rather than less significant amounts with a number
      額。然而，本集團就該等安排所涵蓋的貿              of suppliers. However, the Group’s payment terms for trade payables

      期並無大幅延長，管理層認為供應商融資              does not consider the supplier finance arrangements to result in
      安排不會導致流動資金風險過度集中。有              excessive concentrations of liquidity risk given the payment terms are not
      關安排的詳情於財務報表附註28披露。              significantly extended. Details of the arrangements are disclosed in note
